adblockerDescription: Block ads on every device connected to your router.
connBenchmarkDescription: Run a line test from your router to check you are getting the quality you pay for.
geofilterDescription: Block distant or high-ping servers to improve your gameplay experience.
moreFeaturesSubtitle: Some features are still in development for this Mobile view of $t(branding:dumaosName). For the full $t(branding:dumaosName) feature set, access the Desktop view on PC at {{url}}.

settingsDescription: Access the core settings for your home network and $t(branding:unitName), such as changing your WiFi network name and password.
